gl:definition.gl:content: recall scheme in which the recall set is never enumerated centrally: the recall predicate is published, and each custodian evaluates it locally against their own holdings — including dark and defence holdings under national procedure — and acts

gl:notes.gl:content: The manufacturer receives aggregates or nothing; there is no traversal-push enumeration of the installed base.

One of the mechanisms by which enumeration resistance (concept dpp-0139) is maintained: recall propagation still notifies custodians transitively, but through local predicate evaluation rather than central construction of the recall set.
